# Source: Fragments (Border)

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Fragments (Border)
- **Artist / culture:** Nasca Coyunga, Nazca Valley, South coast, Peru
- **Date:** 100 BCE-200 CE
- **Style:** nazca
- **Classification:** textile
- **Department:** Textiles
- **AIC artwork ID:** 2995
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/2995
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/beb9c895-4d71-d087-95e3-f647882dd9d2/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Ukiyo-e

## Extracted source palette

`#F8F8F8, #482828, #281818, #683828, #885828, #D8E8E8, #983828, #282838`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#150C0C`
- `surface`: `#302828`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#983828`
- `on_primary`: `#F8F8F6`
- `secondary`: `#F8F8F8`
- `surface_variant`: `#302828`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#554E4E`
- `error`: `#983828`
- `on_error`: `#F8F8F6`

- Font: `rounded` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `16dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `18.12:1`, surface `13.53:1`
- Variant contrast: `13.53:1`
- Control contrast: `6.74:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
